Poster Data
 
```{r}
results_cc <- readRDS("outputs/final_cc.rds")
results_mi_500 <- readRDS("outputs/final_mi_500.rds")
results_mi_1000 <- readRDS("outputs/final_mi_1000.rds")
```
 
```{r}
cc_zero <- results_cc %>%
  filter(input_mis_subj == 0) %>%
  mutate(missing_method = "multiple_imputation")

results_mi <- bind_rows(results_mi_500, results_mi_1000)

results_full <- bind_rows(results_cc, results_mi)
results_full <- bind_rows(
  results_full,
  results_full %>%
    filter(missing_method == "complete_case", input_mis_subj == 0) %>%
    mutate(missing_method = "multiple_imputation")
) %>%
  distinct()
```


Change the dataset to long format for easier formatting. 
```{r}
poster_long <- results_full %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^(oracle|mcar|mar|mnar)\\.(mean\\.hr|median\\.hr|bias|rmse|coverage|power)\\.(dfs|os)$"),
    names_to = c("missing_mechanism", "metric", "outcome"),
    names_pattern = "^(oracle|mcar|mar|mnar)\\.(mean\\.hr|median\\.hr|bias|rmse|coverage|power)\\.(dfs|os)$",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    missing_mechanism = toupper(missing_mechanism),
    outcome           = toupper(outcome)
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = metric, values_from = value) %>%
  mutate(
    missing_mechanism = factor(missing_mechanism,
                               levels = c("ORACLE", "MCAR", "MAR", "MNAR")),
    outcome       = factor(outcome, levels = c("DFS", "OS")),
    causal_method = factor(causal_method, levels = c("match", "ebal", "iptw")),
    input_ss      = factor(input_ss),
    missing_method = case_when(
      missing_method == "complete_case"       ~ "Complete Case",
      missing_method == "multiple_imputation" ~ "Multiple Imputation",
      TRUE ~ missing_method
    ),
    input_mis_subj_lab = paste0(100 * input_mis_subj, "%")
  )
```

# Data Generating Data

```{r}
original_data <- read.csv("predata_s2.csv")

original_data_clean <- prep_data(original_data)
pred_vars <- c("Age_Dx_bin", "pT_7th_bin", "pN_7th_bin", 
               "ENE_bin", "PORT_bin", 
               "Max_tumor_size", "Total_LN_positive_")

# 1. Covariate means and covariance matrix
emp_means <- colMeans(original_data_clean[, pred_vars], na.rm=TRUE)
emp_cov   <- cov(original_data_clean[, pred_vars], use="complete.obs")

round(emp_means, 3)
round(emp_cov, 3)

# 2. Binary variable thresholds (quantiles used for dichotomisation)
binary_vars <- c("Age_Dx_bin", "pT_7th_bin", "pN_7th_bin", 
                 "ENE_bin", "PORT_bin")
binary_props <- sapply(binary_vars, function(v) 
  round(mean(original_data_clean[[v]], na.rm=TRUE), 3))
print(binary_props)

# 3. Treatment model coefficients
ps_formula <- as.formula(paste("Treatment ~", 
                                paste(pred_vars, collapse=" + ")))
ps_model <- glm(ps_formula, 
                data=original_data_clean, 
                family=binomial)
round(coef(ps_model), 3)

# 4. Weibull outcome model parameters — DFS
library(survival)
weibull_dfs <- survreg(
  Surv(DFStime, DFS) ~ Age_Dx_bin + pT_7th_bin + pN_7th_bin +
                       ENE_bin + PORT_bin + 
                       Max_tumor_size + Total_LN_positive_,
  data = original_data_clean,
  dist = "weibull"
)
round(coef(weibull_dfs), 3)
round(weibull_dfs$scale, 3)

# 5. Weibull outcome model parameters — OS
weibull_os <- survreg(
  Surv(OStime, OS) ~ Age_Dx_bin + pT_7th_bin + pN_7th_bin +
                     ENE_bin + PORT_bin + 
                     Max_tumor_size + Total_LN_positive_,
  data = original_data_clean,
  dist = "weibull"
)
round(coef(weibull_os), 3)
round(weibull_os$scale, 3)

# 6. Censoring rate
cat("DFS censoring rate:", 
    round(1 - mean(original_data_clean$DFS), 3), "\n")
cat("OS censoring rate:",  
    round(1 - mean(original_data_clean$OS),  3), "\n")
```

# Assumption Checking

```{r}
library(survival)
library(survminer)

# Fit Weibull to real data
weibull_dfs <- survreg(
  Surv(DFStime, DFS) ~ Age_Dx_bin + pT_7th_bin + pN_7th_bin +
                       ENE_bin + PORT_bin +
                       Max_tumor_size + Total_LN_positive_,
  data = original_data_clean,
  dist = "weibull"
)

# Log cumulative hazard plot to verify linearity
# Stratify by strongest confounders
fit_km <- survfit(Surv(DFStime, DFS) ~ ENE_bin,
                  data = original_data_clean)

# Plot log(-log(S(t))) vs log(t)
# Under Weibull this should be linear
ggsurvplot(fit_km,
           fun      = "cloglog",
           palette  = c("#E74C3C", "#3498DB"),
           xlab     = "log(time)",
           ylab     = "log(-log(S(t)))",
           title    = "Log cumulative hazard plot — DFS by ENE status",
           legend.labs = c("ENE absent", "ENE present")) +
  theme_sim()
```

# Proportion Analysis of Our Data Generation

```{r}
# Run Generate on a representative condition many times
# and check the binary variable prevalences

test_cond <- Design_final[1, ]
prevalence_check <- replicate(500, {
  dat <- Generate(test_cond, fixed_objects)
  sapply(c("Age_Dx_bin", "pT_7th_bin", "pN_7th_bin", 
           "ENE_bin", "PORT_bin"),
         function(v) mean(dat$dataset.complete[[v]]))
})

# Compare simulated to empirical
empirical <- c(0.500, 0.389, 0.410, 0.257, 0.594)
simulated  <- rowMeans(prevalence_check)

data.frame(
  variable   = c("Age at Dx", "pT Stage", "pN Stage", "ENE", "PORT"),
  empirical  = round(empirical, 3),
  simulated  = round(simulated, 3),
  difference = round(simulated - empirical, 3)
)
```
```{r}
# Verify the proportion of negative draws across replicates
negative_check <- replicate(500, {
  dat <- Generate(test_cond, fixed_objects)
  # Check how many were truncated by looking at zeros
  # since Generate replaces negatives with zero
  c(
    tumor_zeros = mean(dat$dataset.complete$Max_tumor_size == 0),
    ln_zeros = mean(dat$dataset.complete$Total_LN_positive_ == 0)
  )
})

rowMeans(negative_check)
```


# Main table

```{r}
table_avg <- poster_long %>%
  group_by(outcome, missing_mechanism, input_mis_subj,
           causal_method, missing_method) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_hr = mean(mean.hr,   na.rm = TRUE),
    median_hr = mean(median.hr, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_bias = mean(bias,      na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_rmse = mean(rmse,      na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_coverage = mean(coverage, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(outcome, missing_mechanism, input_mis_subj, causal_method)
write.csv(table_avg, "outputs/table_avg.csv")
```

```{r}
theme_sim <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#f0f0f0", color = NA),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "#cccccc", fill = NA),
      legend.position  = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "#555555")
    )
}

method_colors <- c("match" = "#E74C3C", "ebal" = "#2ECC71", "iptw" = "#3498DB")
mech_levels <- c("MCAR", "MAR", "MNAR")
```

```{r}
plot_base <- table_avg %>%
  filter(missing_mechanism %in% mech_levels)

# ── Plot 1: Coverage ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_coverage <- plot_base %>%
  filter(outcome == "DFS") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = input_mis_subj, y = mean_coverage,
             color = causal_method, group = causal_method)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.95, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_grid(missing_method ~ missing_mechanism) +
  scale_color_manual(values = method_colors, name = "Causal method") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.50),
                     labels = c("0%", "25%", "50%")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.85, 1.00),
                     breaks = seq(0.85, 1.00, by = 0.02)) +
  labs(title    = "Coverage across missingness mechanisms — DFS",
       subtitle = "Dashed line = nominal 0.95 target",
       x = "Missingness proportion",
       y = "Average coverage") +
  theme_sim()

# ── Plot 2: Bias ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_bias <- plot_base %>%
  filter(outcome == "DFS") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = input_mis_subj, y = mean_bias,
             color = causal_method, group = causal_method)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_grid(missing_method ~ missing_mechanism) +
  scale_color_manual(values = method_colors, name = "Causal method") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.50),
                     labels = c("0%", "25%", "50%")) +
  labs(title    = "Bias across missingness mechanisms — DFS",
       subtitle = "Dashed line = zero bias",
       x = "Missingness proportion",
       y = "Mean bias (log HR)") +
  theme_sim()

# ── Plot 3: RMSE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_rmse <- plot_base %>%
  filter(outcome == "DFS") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = input_mis_subj, y = mean_rmse,
             color = causal_method, group = causal_method)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_grid(missing_method ~ missing_mechanism) +
  scale_color_manual(values = method_colors, name = "Causal method") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.50),
                     labels = c("0%", "25%", "50%")) +
  labs(title = "RMSE across missingness mechanisms — DFS",
       x = "Missingness proportion",
       y = "RMSE") +
  theme_sim()

# ── Plot 4: Coverage heatmap ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_heat_coverage <- plot_base %>%
  filter(outcome == "DFS") %>%
  mutate(
    mis_lab = paste0(input_mis_subj * 100, "%"),
    coverage_cat = case_when(
      mean_coverage < 0.90  ~ "< 0.90",
      mean_coverage < 0.93  ~ "0.90-0.93",
      mean_coverage < 0.95  ~ "0.93-0.95",
      mean_coverage <= 0.97 ~ "0.95-0.97",
      TRUE                  ~ "> 0.97"
    ),
    coverage_cat = factor(coverage_cat,
                          levels = c("< 0.90", "0.90-0.93", "0.93-0.95",
                                     "0.95-0.97", "> 0.97"))
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mis_lab, y = causal_method, fill = coverage_cat)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(mean_coverage, 3)), size = 3) +
  facet_grid(missing_method ~ missing_mechanism) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("< 0.90"    = "#d73027",
               "0.90-0.93" = "#fc8d59",
               "0.93-0.95" = "#fee090",
               "0.95-0.97" = "#91cf60",
               "> 0.97"    = "#1a9850"),
    name = "Coverage"
  ) +
  labs(title = "Coverage heatmap — DFS",
       x = "Missingness proportion",
       y = "Causal method") +
  theme_sim()

# ── Plot 5: Bias heatmap ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_heat_bias <- plot_base %>%
  filter(outcome == "DFS") %>%
  mutate(mis_lab = paste0(input_mis_subj * 100, "%")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mis_lab, y = causal_method, fill = mean_bias)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(mean_bias, 3)), size = 3) +
  facet_grid(missing_method ~ missing_mechanism) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#3498DB", mid = "white", high = "#E74C3C",
                       midpoint = 0, name = "Bias\n(log HR)") +
  labs(title = "Bias heatmap — DFS",
       x = "Missingness proportion",
       y = "Causal method") +
  theme_sim()

# ── Plot 6: Coverage boxplot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_coverage_box <- plot_base %>%
  filter(outcome == "DFS") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = causal_method, y = mean_coverage, fill = causal_method)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = 21, outlier.size = 1.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.95, linetype = "dashed",
             linewidth = 0.5, color = "red") +
  facet_grid(missing_method ~ missing_mechanism) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = method_colors) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of coverage probabilities — DFS",
       x = "Causal method",
       y = "Coverage probability") +
  theme_sim() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p_coverage_box_os <- plot_base %>%
  filter(outcome == "OS") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = causal_method, y = mean_coverage, fill = causal_method)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = 21, outlier.size = 1.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.95, linetype = "dashed",
             linewidth = 0.5, color = "red") +
  facet_grid(missing_method ~ missing_mechanism) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = method_colors) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of coverage probabilities — OS",
       x = "Causal method",
       y = "Coverage probability") +
  theme_sim() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# ── Plot 7: Combined coverage + bias (poster style) ───────────────────────────
p_combined_dfs <- (p_coverage + p_bias) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# OS versions
p_coverage_os <- plot_base %>%
  filter(outcome == "OS") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = input_mis_subj, y = mean_coverage,

  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_grid(missing_method ~ missing_mechanism) +
  scale_color_manual(values = method_colors, name = "Causal method") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.50),
                     labels = c("0%", "25%", "50%")) +
  labs(title = "Coverage across missingness mechanisms — OS",
       subtitle = "Dashed line = nominal 0.95 target",
       x = "Missingness proportion",
       y = "Average coverage") +
  theme_sim()

p_bias_os <- plot_base %>%
  filter(outcome == "OS") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = input_mis_subj, y = mean_bias,

p_combined_os <- patchwork::wrap_plots(p_coverage_os + p_bias_os) +

# Plot 8: Confounding Plot

table_avg_confounding <- poster_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(outcome, missing_mechanism, input_mis_subj,
                  missing_method, confounding_scale) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_bias     = mean(bias,      na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_rmse     = mean(rmse,      na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_coverage = mean(coverage,  na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

plot_base_confounding <- table_avg_confounding %>%
  filter(missing_mechanism %in% mech_levels)

p_confounding <- plot_base_confounding %>%
  dplyr::filter(outcome == "DFS") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = input_mis_subj, y = mean_bias,
```

```{r}
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mis_lab, y = causal_method, fill = coverage_cat)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(mean_coverage, 3)), size = 3) +
  facet_grid(missing_method ~ missing_mechanism) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("< 0.90"    = "#d73027",
               "0.90-0.93" = "#fc8d59",
               "0.93-0.95" = "#fee090",
               "0.95-0.97" = "#91cf60",
               "> 0.97"    = "#1a9850"),
    name = "Coverage"
  ) +
  labs(title = "Coverage heatmap — OS",
       x = "Missingness proportion",
       y = "Causal method") +
  theme_sim()

# ── OS: Bias heatmap ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_heat_bias_os <- plot_base %>%
  dplyr::filter(outcome == "OS") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(mis_lab = paste0(input_mis_subj * 100, "%")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mis_lab, y = causal_method, fill = mean_bias)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(mean_bias, 3)), size = 3) +
  facet_grid(missing_method ~ missing_mechanism) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#3498DB", mid = "white", high = "#E74C3C",
                       midpoint = 0, name = "Bias\n(log HR)") +
  labs(title = "Bias heatmap — OS",
       x = "Missingness proportion",
       y = "Causal method") +
  theme_sim()

# ── OS: Confounding ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_confounding_os <- plot_base_confounding %>%
  dplyr::filter(outcome == "OS") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = input_mis_subj, y = mean_bias,
             color = factor(confounding_scale),
             group = factor(confounding_scale))) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_grid(missing_method ~ missing_mechanism) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("0.5" = "#3498DB", "1" = "#E74C3C", "2" = "#2ECC71"),
    name = "Confounding scale"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.50),
                     labels = c("0%", "25%", "50%")) +
  labs(title = "Bias across missingness mechanisms by confounding scale — OS",
       x = "Missingness proportion",
       y = "Mean bias (log HR)") +
  theme_sim()

# ── OS: Sample size ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_sample_size_os <- plot_base_ss %>%
  dplyr::filter(outcome == "OS") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = input_mis_subj, y = mean_coverage,
             color = factor(input_ss),
             group = factor(input_ss))) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.95, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_grid(missing_method ~ missing_mechanism) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("500" = "#E74C3C", "1000" = "#3498DB"),
    name = "Sample size"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.50),
                     labels = c("0%", "25%", "50%")) +
  labs(title = "Coverage across missingness mechanisms by sample size — OS",
       x = "Missingness proportion",
       y = "Average coverage") +
  theme_sim()
print(p_bias_os)
print(p_rmse_os)
print(p_heat_coverage_os)
print(p_confounding_os)
print(p_sample_size_os)

# ── Save OS plots ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggsave("practicum_paper/outputs/p_bias_os.png",
       p_bias_os, width=10, height=6, dpi=300)
ggsave("practicum_paper/outputs/p_rmse_os.png",
       p_rmse_os, width=10, height=6, dpi=300)
ggsave("practicum_paper/outputs/p_heat_coverage_os.png",
       p_heat_coverage_os, width=10, height=6, dpi=300)
ggsave("practicum_paper/outputs/p_heat_bias_os.png",
       p_heat_bias_os, width=10, height=6, dpi=300)
ggsave("practicum_paper/outputs/p_confounding_os.png",
       p_confounding_os, width=14, height=6, dpi=300)
ggsave("practicum_paper/outputs/p_sample_size_os.png",
       p_sample_size_os, width=14, height=6, dpi=300)
```
